decision_cutoff_rule.justification: In the Great Britain electricity market, EPEX SPOT GB Day-Ahead auction order books close at 09:20 UK local time (N2EX closes at 09:50/11:00). A purchasing team must lock physical wind positions by 09:00 UTC on D-1 (GMT in January) to determine net trade requirements prior to gate closure.
decision_cutoff_rule.selection_logic: For each delivery hour t on day D, select the latest forecast published at or before T_cutoff. Forecasts published after cutoff are strictly excluded. Retrospective records (lead time <= 0) are eliminated.
decision_cutoff_rule.lead_time_definition: Lead time = (startTime - publishTime) in hours. Under 09:00 D-1 cutoff, lead times range from 15h to 38h.

method_a_primary.name: hourly_mean
method_a_primary.description: Mean of the two 30-minute settlement periods (2k-1 and 2k) comprising the hour.
method_a_primary.validation: Strictly requires both half-hour intervals to be present and non-null; otherwise the hour is omitted.

method_b_check.name: point_match
method_b_check.description: Uses the single outturn record starting at :00 without aggregation.

metric_definitions.mae: Mean Absolute Error: (1/N) * sum(|Forecast - Actual|) in MW.
metric_definitions.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error: sqrt((1/N) * sum((Forecast - Actual)^2)) in MW. Penalizes large errors.
metric_definitions.mean_error_bias: Mean Error: (1/N) * sum(Forecast - Actual) in MW. Positive indicates over-forecasting.
metric_definitions.mape: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (%): strictly excludes intervals where Actual == 0 to prevent division by zero.
metric_definitions.wape: Weighted Absolute Percentage Error (%): sum(|Forecast - Actual|) / sum(Actual) * 100.

data_coverage.january_boundary_handling: WINDFOR has a ~66.5h maximum forecast horizon. Forecasts for 2026-01-01 delivery are published beginning in late December 2025. The backend automatically fetches from 2025-12-28 onward.
data_coverage.caching: All raw API responses are persisted to data/cache with a 24-hour TTL.
